name: 薄皮多汁现摘蜜桔款

styleLock.backgroundSystem: dark espresso wood #241B12 for the moody hero, clean white #FFFFFF for info screens, warm cream #F7EAD2 for trust and scene shots
styleLock.lightingSystem: soft warm top or top-left key with gentle fill, soft contact shadows, 4500-5500K, natural dewy highlights, no harsh speculars and no plastic look
styleLock.surfaceSystem: rustic dark wood, bamboo basket, matte ceramic bowl, plaid linen and kraft paper
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headline type in the single accent color
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line fruit doodle icons, circular callout badges and rounded ribbon banners in a single accent color
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and scale; whole-fruit and cut-fruit states kept consistent across the set; fresh green #4A7C3F leaves as recurring garnish
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh citrus fruit ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, vivid mandarin orange #F09A1A, deep espresso brown #241B12 and fresh leaf green accent #4A7C3F; warm tone throughout; soft warm key light with gentle fill, soft contact shadows, natural dewy fruit texture with no plastic look; modern geometric sans-serif headline type only; consistent rounded ribbon banners, circular callout badges and hexagonal image masks; clean food photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product scale and placement with fresh green #4A7C3F leaves as recurring garnish; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 从 8 张生鲜柑橘类爆款详情切片提炼；已剥离含地名的书法标题、全部原文案、图形角标与扫码元素；产地、农法、光照时长、营养等无法核实的声明不进图，信任表达只保留满筐鲜果、果肉微距与防损装箱等可验证画面，产品一律以 {product} 占位。
